build_composite_optimizer: build a FairseqCompositeOptimizer with multiple parameter groups each using a different optimizer config
create_optimizer_config: create a CompositeOptimizerConfig dataclass to define per-group optimizer and lr scheduler settings
create_scheduler_config: create an OptimizerAndSchedulerConfig dataclass to pair an optimizer config with an lr scheduler config
step_composite_optimizer: step the CompositeOptimizer across all registered sub-optimizers optionally filtered by group names
step_lr_scheduler: step the CompositeLRScheduler to update learning rates across all per-group lr schedulers
